description: Machine-readable grouping of the fourteen primitives into the six candidate directions. This closes the evidence gap identified in the 2026-09-17 agenda audit: the direction coverage numbers 146/138/136 were computed from an oral grouping that was never stored. Each direction defines a core set (exact-match membership rule), an extended set (candidates for the sensitivity analysis), and a written rationale.

directions.name: Research Object Identity and Lineage
directions.rationale: Canonical identity resolution (1) and provenance lineage (2) are the direction's two named pillars. Normalization (6) serves identity directly and is included in the extended set only.
directions.membership_rule: An item is covered if its primitive set intersects the direction's primitive set (union of core and extended, per sensitivity run).

directions.name: Method / Supplement Miner
directions.rationale: Method lineage is a subset of provenance (2); supplement cross-referencing is cross-artifact linking (10). Coverage-map accounting of figures and supplements (8) is the extended candidate.

directions.name: Claim-Evidence Graph
directions.rationale: The claim-citation-evidence chain consumes Evidence Receipts (5) and links claim to work to passage (10). Items whose support state is genuinely undecidable route to the uncertainty queue (12), hence extended only.

directions.name: Decision / Negative Result Ledger
directions.rationale: The ledger is a state ledger (3). Decision evolution over time can draw on lineage (2); included in the extended set to test whether it changes the ranking.

directions.name: Learning Error + Adaptive Practice
directions.rationale: Error taxonomy and adaptive practice are the adaptive practice engine (14). Retrieval and resurfacing (9) support forgetting curves and spaced practice; extended only.

directions.name: Constraint Compiler
directions.rationale: Rule compilation is the constraint compiler (7). Verifying the compiled artifact deterministically is the verifier (11); extended only.
